text:
Carla (mktg): Planning a 72-hour paid push for Aug 29 webinar. Mix: search + retarget + discovery. Need final budget, negative keyword list, and swap rules.

Ben (growth): Budget ask? markets?

Carla (mktg): $1,400/day for 3 days = $4,200. Markets: US + CA + UK. KPI CPL <$48, target 120 regs over 72h. Reserve 30% of total for final 24h surge.

Noor (creative): I'll make three creative bundles: Technical (engineer-focused), Business (value props), and Urgency (countdown). We'll test CTA variants "Reserve" vs "Save spot".

Zack (analytics): Landing page split: 55% technical LP (more specs), 45% short LP (agenda + CTA). Add hidden field reg_uuid. GA4 events: webinar_reg, webinar_attend_30.

Mira (ops): Lead routing: register -> SFDC "Aug29_Webinar_PTF". Attended (>=30%) -> mark MQL and push to SDR queue. Need HubSpot API key after QA.

Ben (growth): Campaign structure:
- Search: 5 tightly themed ad groups (inference, production, latency, cost, devtools)
- Discovery/YouTube: small budget for awareness plus retarget seed
- Retarget: 7-day site visitors and 14-day engaged viewers
- Negative keywords: free trial, tutorial, university, internship (Noor please add suggestions)

Carla (mktg): Pacing rules: no more than 35% of daily in first 6 hours; reserve 30% for final day. If CPA > $60 after 12h, cut search by 45% and increase retarget bid 20%.

Ben (growth): Bidding: portfolio tCPA target $45. Use bid caps per ad group: $10 for core, $8 for long-tail. Enable dayparting boost +15% 8-11am local.

Noor (creative): Creative swap triggers:
- If CTR <0.5% after 6h -> swap to Urgency bundle.
- If CTR >1.2% but conv rate <6% -> swap to Technical LP variant.
- If bounce rate >70% from discovery -> pause discovery and push to retarget.
I'll upload assets to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/aug29_assets (placeholder).

Zack (analytics): Tracking: set UTM campaign=aug29_webinar, content={creative}, term={keyword}. Add session_stitch cookie to join ad -> reg -> attend. Alert: CPA > $55 -> @Ben + @Carla.

Mira (ops): QA checklist: UTMs, form validation, pixel firing, Zap to HubSpot, negative keyword list applied. I will run staging Zap test.

ads-bot: Draft campaign created: id=cmp_aug29_199, url=https://ads.internal/cmp_aug29_199

Ben (growth): Also add an exclusion audience: past 90-day registrants and current customers. Prevent duplicate spend.

Carla (mktg): Agree. One final ask: test a short lead magnet on retarget LP ("inference checklist PDF") to lift NUR. Noor, add a creative with pdf CTA.

Noor (creative): On it.

Zack (analytics): I'll add a dashboard tile for hourly CPA and a short watch rule for attendance.

Mira (ops): Zap staging passed. Will request prod keys after creative upload.

Carla (mktg): Timeline: assets by 4pm, draft in ads UI by 6pm, QA + go-live tomorrow 10am PT. Owner for go = @Mira.

Ben (growth): I'll monitor the first 3 hours and post updates.

Carla (mktg): Thanks team. Approvals: Noor yes, Zack yes, Mira yes.

ads-bot: campaign cmp_aug29_199 moved to pending_review by Mira

Carla (mktg): End thread  — will post go-live and first-hour snapshot when live.
